task_description: Build a complete, rubric-maximizing Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui frontend for the existing MotorCenter Express/MongoDB backend, covering all five roles (pelanggan, kasir, admin, mekanik, pemilik), the 5-stage sequential service flow, and the two G6 third-party surfaces (automated email notices + PDF invoice download). Also verify the backend already satisfies rubric points BE1-BE5 and record evidence, fixing only genuine defects. Default to a dummy MongoDB connection with clearly documented instructions for switching to a real Atlas string; never commit secrets.
